description: Scores a commercial food facility's physical layout and structural preparedness against R638 audit requirements, identifying critical non-conformances. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'calculate_facility_hygiene_readiness' on Food Compliance Agency (foodcompliance.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'check_coa_requirements' or 'get_municipal_health_guidelines' or 'get_food_handler_training_standards' for their respective operations). Parameters: has_dedicated_handwash_basin (required), has_double_compartment_sink (required), has_separate_prep_sink (optional), walls_impervious_tiled (required), floors_smooth_coved (required), has_grease_trap (optional), pest_control_contract (optional), trained_person_in_charge (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

floors_smooth_coved.description: Impervious, non-slip flooring with coved rounded skirting. [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

has_dedicated_handwash_basin.description: Dedicated basin with liquid soap and disposable paper towels. [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

has_double_compartment_sink.description: Dual pot sink with hot water for sanitizing. [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

has_grease_trap.description: Functional vented fat trap on wash basins. [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

has_separate_prep_sink.description: Dedicated sink for vegetable or raw meat preparation. [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

pest_control_contract.description: Active pest management service contract and bait stations. [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

trained_person_in_charge.description: Certified PIC under Regulation R638. [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

walls_impervious_tiled.description: Light-colored washable tiled or epoxy walls up to min 1.8m. [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

name: calculate_facility_hygiene_readiness
title: Calculate Facility Hygiene Readiness
